scene: Inside the cabin, the crane lowers you to the transit hub.
picture: A wide multi-level transit depot on flat concrete. On the far left sits a waiting street tram. The young Black woman in yellow raincoat, green boots, and red umbrella stands at centre. Up high rests an open orange cable car, and a glowing subway entrance opens on the far right.
shown: a sleek street tram with open folding doors waiting on the far left
an orange cable car hanging open at a suspended platform up high
a tiled subway stairwell with a lit neon sign on the far right
